settings.intro_text:
Humidity has a way of settling into your home without making a big entrance. It starts small, the air feels a little heavier, certain rooms feel harder to sit in, and things don’t dry as quickly as they should. But over time, it builds into something you notice every single day.

This guide is built around that exact experience. Not from a feature-first angle, but from what actually changes how your home feels. What reduces that constant heaviness, what makes the air feel lighter again, and which dehumidifiers genuinely make a difference when this becomes part of your daily environment.
settings.author_bio_override:
Daniel works on evaluating home comfort products with a focus on how they perform in everyday use, not just in ideal conditions. His work involves comparing different systems across real home environments to understand what actually improves comfort over time.

He has been involved in projects with teams connected to Honeywell Home, where the focus was on testing air and climate products beyond just specifications.

For this guide, his role is simple, filtering out what sounds good and focusing only on what genuinely makes a home feel more comfortable and balanced.
